findings.location: Article paragraphs quoting Scripture: Matthew 6:27, 34; 1 Peter 4:12–13; 2 Timothy 1:7; Luke 10:27; John 16:33
findings.suggested_fix: Use conventional Kiswahili book names in the references while preserving the exact chapter and verse numbers, ranges, and placement: “–Mt 6:27, 34”; “–1 Petro 4: 12-13”; “–2 Timotheo 1:7”; “–Luka 10:27”; “–Yohana 16:33.”
